Something I Need You To Know

From My Heart, Directly To Yours.

"Maybe I can't give you your father's love.
That love is irreplaceable — and I would never pretend otherwise.

But I promise you this, Sibani —
No one in this world will ever love you
the way I do.

Not the same. Not close. Not even a little bit.
My love for you is entirely its own thing —
stubborn, loud, ridiculous, and completely, unconditionally yours."

Happy Birthday to the woman who deserves every kind of love this world has. You have mine. All of it. Always.

The Real Reasons

Why I'm Hopelessly In Love With You

01
🫂

You Get Me Without Trying

I barely finish the sentence and you already know. Which is wonderful and slightly terrifying. You understand parts of me I haven't figured out yet.

02
🌪️

You Match My Chaos

You don't just tolerate my madness — you show up with your own. We're the same kind of weird. You don't find that twice. You hold onto it.

03
🔥

You Never Backed Down

We've had our Tom & Jerry moments — dramatic, ridiculous, the full circus. But you never once walked away from what we are. That means everything.

04
😂

You Make Me Ugly-Laugh

The kind that makes no sound. The kind that hurts. That can only happen with one person in the whole world. That person is you. Lucky me.

05
🌟

You Believe In Me

There's this stubborn, ridiculous faith you have in me that I haven't always deserved. It's pushed me further than anything else ever could. You made me braver.

06
🌙

You're My 3AM Person

When the world goes quiet and thoughts get loud — you're who I reach for. Not just for fun. For the stuff that actually matters. My safe place.

07
💪

You're Stronger Than You Know

You've carried things quietly that would break most people. And you never stopped showing up — for yourself, for the people you love. That takes real courage.

08
♾️

Seven Years & Still Choosing You

Not out of habit. Not out of comfort. But because of who you are — specifically, stubbornly, completely you. Every single day.

✦   The Final Word   ✦

You Are My Forever.

Happy Birthday, Sibani 🎂

Seven years of chasing each other, annoying each other, and somehow — falling deeper in love. You are the Tom to my Jerry, the chaos to my calm, the missing piece to my everything.

I wouldn't trade a single chaotic second of it.
